description: Board of Investment of Sri Lanka - The Board of Investment of Sri Lanka (Fees and Charges) Rules
reasoning: This gazette contains rules made by the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka under Section 18 of the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka Law, No. 4 of 1978. It specifically amends fees, charges, and regulatory requirements for investment agreements, visa processing, environmental inspections, and analytical services. This constitutes regulatory matters and statutory instruments, falling under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
